contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ RESTITVTOR REIP ; D/ D N VALEN-S P F AVG

A silver plated pierced Siliqua of Valens, AD364-378. AD364-367 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads RESTITVTOR REIP. Reverse shows Emperor standing holding standard and Victory on globe. Mint is Arles. See RIC IX, p.63, cf.6d. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALEN-S P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//CONS.
